personality_one_liner: An intimate, tactile, and warmly imperfect scrapbook for two.

spacing.rule: Generous, breathable rhythm mimicking a physical journal. Never dense. Use xl/2xl for major sections.

do's: Avoid glass entirely for this personality to preserve the matte, paper-like journal feel.
dont's: No blur effects on tab bars, modals, or headers.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Authenticate one of the two exclusive users to enter their private space.

states.error: Soft error toast with surfaceInverse background.

screens.layout: Minimalist layout. A large hero illustration (line art) at the top. App title 'DuoVault' in oversized Fraunces display font. Two clean text inputs (Username, Password) spaced with 'xl'. A sticky primary CTA 'Enter' pinned to the bottom. Background is solid 'surface'.

screens.name: FirstTimePasswordChange
screens.purpose: Mandatory security step for the initial login.

states.error: Inline error text below input in 'error' color.

screens.layout: Text-heavy editorial layout. 'Secure Our Vault' as large title. Old Password, New Password, Confirm Password inputs. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Gallery
screens.purpose: A shared scrapbook of memories with multi-select support.

states.loading: Skeleton frames of various heights mimicking photos.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty notebook with 'Start our scrapbook' text.

screens.layout: Scrapbook masonry or staggered grid for photo/video cards. Cards use mixed radii (some md, some lg) to feel imperfectly cut. Top header features a 'Select' button for multi-select. When in selection mode, a sticky bottom bar appears with 'Delete' and 'Create with AI' actions.

screens.name: Chat

states.empty: Soft text 'Say hello' in the center.
states.error: Failed to load messages with retry.

screens.layout: Paper-like chat bubbles. Partner's bubbles are 'surfaceSecondary', own bubbles are 'brandTertiary'. No sharp tails, just rounded 'md' and 'lg' rectangles. Input field pinned to the bottom inside a 'surface' container. No glass.

screens.name: Scribble
screens.purpose: A blank canvas for handwritten notes or drawings.
screens.layout: Full-screen 'surfaceSecondary' canvas resembling paper. A floating bottom toolbar containing drawing tools (brush, eraser, colors) and a 'Save to Gallery' button.

screens.name: AI Studio
screens.purpose: Transform selected photos into new art pieces via prompts.

states.loading: Pulsing animation on the selected photos.
states.empty: Prompt to select photos from the gallery.
states.error: Error text below the prompt box.

screens.layout: Watercolor textured background. At the top, a horizontal scrolling row or overlapping stack of the selected source photos. Below, a large 'surface' multiline text input for the AI prompt. Sticky 'Magic' CTA at the bottom. Once generated, result displays in a prominent polaroid-style frame.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage personal info and view partner connection.
screens.layout: Editorial-style top section with avatar (or initials circle using 'brandPrimary') and large Name/Nickname. Stacked read-only fields for username and mobile number. A 'surfaceSecondary' card for Settings. 'Log Out' as a 'surfaceInverse' secondary button at the bottom.

login_hero.alt: Minimalist romantic couple line art drawing

gallery_empty.alt: Empty notebook page on a minimal desk

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Hand-Drawn / Journal LIGHT' personality. The aesthetic relies heavily on off-white surfaces, sage accents, and irregular shapes.
Use a 4-tab bottom navigation: Gallery, Chat, Create, Profile. The 'Create' tab should open a bottom sheet offering 'Upload Photo/Video', 'Scribble', and 'AI Studio' options.
Do not use any glassmorphism or blur effects. Solid 'surface' and 'surfaceSecondary' layers only.
For the Gallery, implement a staggered or masonry layout to simulate a scrapbook. Allow long press or a 'Select' header button to enter multi-select mode.

Always apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 1: expo-linear-gradient vertical 0% transparent to 100% surfaceInverse >=70%) when overlaying text on images, such as inside Gallery cards if they have captions.
Use 'Fraunces' for display titles and 'Nunito' for body text. Cap all font weights at 400 or 500.
Ensure sticky buttons at the bottom of scrollable views (Login, AI Studio, Password Change) have safe-area padding and a solid background to obscure scrolling content.
